VTU students 👋

Free self-learning app for 1BAIA103 Introduction to Artificial Intelligence (Module 1).

• Classroom notes (cited to the class text)
• VTU-style exam questions — type your answer and get feedback
• Slides + lecture

Prepared under the guidance of Dr. Lokesh M R, Professor, ISE, AJIET Mangaluru (VTU, Belagavi).

Open here (no login):
https://lokeshmr23.github.io/VTUHub-1BAIA103-Module-1-self-learning-app/

Please share with your class group.

3) LINKEDIN (author / faculty)
============================================================
I am pleased to share VTUHub, a free self-learning web application for VTU course 1BAIA103 — Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and its Applications (Module 1).

Students can:
• read paraphrased classroom notes with cited figures and tables
• practise SEE/CIE-style questions and type answers
• receive concept-wise feedback and suggested revision
• use classroom slides and a spoken lecture

Class text: Dr. Lokesh M R, Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and its Applications, Module 1 Part A, Department of ISE, A J Institute of Engineering and Technology, Mangaluru (affiliated to VTU, Belagavi).

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages (no login, no fee):
https://lokeshmr23.github.io/VTUHub-1BAIA103-Module-1-self-learning-app/

Grateful to VTU, Belagavi, and AJIET, Mangaluru. Dedicated to every VTU student who aspires to excel in the examination.

#VTU #AJIET #ArtificialIntelligence #1BAIA103 #EngineeringEducation #Mangaluru
